roles.name: surface-0
roles.purpose: The window backdrop, the plane everything else sits on.

roles.name: surface-1
roles.purpose: Bands fixed to the window edge: title bar, step rail, side panel.

roles.name: surface-2
roles.purpose: Strips and toolbars inside the work area.

roles.name: surface-3
roles.purpose: The most raised plane: cards, popups, dialogs, panel headers.

roles.name: control
roles.purpose: The resting fill of a secondary control: buttons, tracks, thumbs.

roles.name: control-hover
roles.purpose: The same control under the pointer.

roles.name: control-active
roles.purpose: The same control while it is being pressed.

roles.name: text-1
roles.purpose: Primary text: values, titles, the label on a hovered button.

roles.name: text-2
roles.purpose: Secondary text: body copy, the label on a resting button.

roles.name: text-3
roles.purpose: Captions, row labels, units, hints.

roles.name: text-4
roles.purpose: The faintest text allowed: uppercase section labels, placeholders, disabled controls. Never a sentence.

roles.name: accent
roles.purpose: The one colour that marks the action moving the workflow forward.

roles.name: accent-hover
roles.purpose: The accent fill under the pointer.

roles.name: accent-active
roles.purpose: The accent fill while it is being pressed.

roles.name: on-accent
roles.purpose: Text and glyphs drawn on an accent fill.

roles.name: accent-text
roles.purpose: The accent used as a text colour, and as the focus ring. On light palettes this is a darker shade of the same hue than the fill.

roles.name: accent-surface
roles.purpose: A surface tinted toward the accent: active tab, selected row, chip.

roles.name: accent-surface-hover
roles.purpose: The same tinted surface under the pointer.

roles.name: ok
roles.purpose: A filled indicator that something succeeded.

roles.name: warn
roles.purpose: A filled indicator that something needs attention.

roles.name: err
roles.purpose: A filled indicator that something failed.

roles.name: on-status
roles.purpose: Text and glyphs drawn on an ok, warn or err fill.

roles.name: ok-text
roles.purpose: A success colour used as text, with no fill behind it.

roles.name: warn-text
roles.purpose: A warning colour used as text, with no fill behind it.

roles.name: err-text
roles.purpose: A failure colour used as text, with no fill behind it.

roles.name: warn-surface
roles.purpose: A surface tinted toward warn: the caution note, the chip on a condition the user should see before going on.

roles.name: err-surface
roles.purpose: A surface tinted toward err: the destructive button.

roles.name: err-surface-hover
roles.purpose: The same tinted surface under the pointer.

roles.name: scrim
roles.purpose: Covers the work area while the application is busy.

roles.name: shadow
roles.purpose: The colour a popup casts. Used inside a box-shadow.

roles.name: overlay
roles.purpose: A plate drawn over content of an unknown colour, such as the label over a photograph.

metrics.name: r-xs
metrics.purpose: A field you type or pick into.

metrics.name: r
metrics.purpose: Anything you press: buttons, tabs, chips, rows.

metrics.name: r-md
metrics.purpose: A raised card, or a plate over the stage.

metrics.name: r-lg
metrics.purpose: A framed pane, a dialog, an image.

metrics.name: r-pill
metrics.purpose: A pill: any height, fully round ends.

metrics.name: font
metrics.purpose: Every piece of text but the application name.

metrics.name: font-brand
metrics.value: 'Abadi','Abadi MT Std','Segoe UI Variable Display','Selawik','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif
metrics.purpose: The application name in the title bar, and nothing else. A modern humanist sans if the machine has one, Segoe UI Variable next on Windows 11, plain Segoe UI last.

metrics.name: mono
metrics.purpose: Numbers in a column, paths, anything measured.

metrics.name: fs
metrics.purpose: Body.

metrics.name: fs-sm
metrics.purpose: Captions.

metrics.name: fs-xs
metrics.purpose: Uppercase section labels.

metrics.name: fs-lg
metrics.purpose: Panel titles.

metrics.name: tbar-h
metrics.purpose: The thick end, on the left, under the logo and the name.

metrics.name: tbar-thin
metrics.purpose: The thin end, on the right, under the window buttons.

metrics.name: tbar-slant
metrics.purpose: The horizontal run of the oblique between the two.

metrics.name: tbar-join
metrics.purpose: The radius the oblique's two vertices are rounded by.

metrics.name: tab-h
metrics.purpose: The height of the rail and of a step tab.

metrics.name: tab-w
metrics.purpose: Every step tab is this wide, so the numbers line up in one column and the initials in another. They shrink together, never one at a time, when the window is narrow.

metrics.name: rp-w
metrics.purpose: The width of the panel down the right.

metrics.name: t-in
metrics.purpose: A control answering the pointer.

metrics.name: t-out
metrics.purpose: The same control letting go.

metrics.name: t-chg
metrics.purpose: A state changing on its own: a status dot, a step marked done.

gold-dark.name: Gold Dark
gold-dark.note: Gold on near black. It's the palette the design was drawn in.

gold-light.name: Gold Light
gold-light.note: The same gold on paper. The surfaces and the text are the ones a printed report uses.

teal-dark.name: Teal Dark
teal-dark.note: Gold Dark with a teal accent in front.

blue-dark.name: Blue Dark
blue-dark.note: Gold Dark with a blue accent in front.

purple-dark.name: Purple Dark
purple-dark.note: Gold Dark with a purple accent in front.

green-dark.name: Green Dark
green-dark.note: Gold Dark with a green accent in front. The accent and the ok colour share a hue here, so read the shape, not the colour.

slate-light.name: Slate Light
slate-light.note: Cool greys and a blue accent, for an application that should not look like the default.

high-contrast.name: High Contrast
high-contrast.note: Pure black, pure white, saturated accents. Nothing in it is near a threshold, and the surfaces are far enough apart to be told apart without a divider.
